# Risom

Risom is the author credited with the Danish National Clinical Guideline (Nationale Kliniske Retningslinje) on rehabilitation for patients with atrial fibrillation, as well as related studies on patient education, cited within the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) quality program documentation[^src1]. The name appears exclusively in the context of Chapter 8 of the AFDK 2024 report, which documents Indicator 8 ("Struktureret patientuddannelse" / Structured Patient Education) — a chapter grounded in both European ESC guidelines and Danish national clinical guidelines, and which also describes the ABC Pathway model for integrated atrial fibrillation care (covering stroke prevention, symptom control, and cardiovascular risk reduction)[^src1].

According to the report, Risom's 2019 guideline provides a strong recommendation that patients newly diagnosed with atrial fibrillation participate in cardiac rehabilitation that includes patient education[^src1]. The same 2019 work is cited to explain the underlying purpose of patient education: strengthening patients' self-care, coping skills, and self-determination, thereby improving health status and quality of life and equipping patients with tools to live with a chronic illness[^src1]. A separate, earlier publication — Risom et al., 2018 — is cited for the methodological principle that patient education should be grounded in a theoretical model and carried out through active collaboration between patient and healthcare professionals[^src1].

The timeline places Risom's work in two steps: a 2018 study on patients' experiences with individual education about atrial fibrillation, and the 2019 publication of the Danish National Clinical Guideline for rehabilitation of atrial fibrillation patients[^src1]. No further biographical, institutional, or relational information about Risom is provided in the corpus; no relationships or additional claims beyond the guideline authorship are recorded.

- Page 97: "Formålet med patientuddannelse er at styrke patienternes egenomsorg, handlekompetencer og selvbestemmelse, og hermed øge patienternes helbredsstatus og livskvalitet samt give dem redskaber til at leve livet med en kronisk sygdom (Risom, 2019)" [^src1]
- Page 97: "Patientuddannelse bør forankres i en teoretisk model, og udføres i et aktivt samarbejde mellem patient og sundhedsprofessionelle (Risom et al., 2018)" [^src1]
